∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r p : ℕ} (J : ℕ) (G : ℝ),
  0 < G →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
      Summable R.d →
        ∀ (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ),
          U.transpose * U = 1 →
            ∀ (L m C₀ C_T C_R : ℝ),
              0 < m →
                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                    BfgsVerification.sqNorm (U.transpose.mulVec ((R.shift J).gradientChange k)) ≤
                      L * (R.shift J).curvature k) →
                  ∀ (V Z : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat p)
                    (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec p),
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec ((R.shift J).g k))) →
                      (∀ (k : ℕ),
                          BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec ((R.shift J).gradientChange k)) ≤
                            C₀ * (R.shift J).curvature k) →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ),
                            V (k + 1) =
                              V k * T k +
                                  BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter ((R.shift J).displacement k) (b k) +
                                Z k) →
                          (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.FrameBounds.OperatorSqBound (T k) (1 + C_T * (R.shift J).d k)) →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), U * U.transpose * Z k = Z k) →
                              (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.SmoothSubspace.frobSq (Z k) ≤ C_R * (R.shift J).d k) → False

∀ {n : ℕ} (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (G c : ℝ),
  0 < G →
    0 < c →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ), c ≤ R.beta k) →
          Summable R.d →
            ∀ (J m : ℕ),
              0 < m →
                ∀ (η : ℝ),
                  0 < η →
                    let D := ∑' (i : ℕ), R.d (J + i);
                    let V :=
                      BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.weightedPotential n (4 * G ^ 2 / c ^ 2 / η)
                        (BfgsVerification.principalSum (R.H J));
                    ↑(m + 1) * (G ^ 2 * V) ^ (-1 / ↑(m + 1)) * (η + D / (c * ↑m)) ^ (-↑m / ↑(m + 1)) ≤
                      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (R.q (J + i))⁻¹

∀ {n r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (a x z : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ℝ) (τ : ℝ → ℝ),
  let β := BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.cutoffSlope τ (BfgsVerification.dot a x - b) (BfgsVerification.dot a z - b);
  BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.cutoffFrame U a (τ (BfgsVerification.dot a z - b)) =
    BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.cutoffFrame U a (τ (BfgsVerification.dot a x - b)) * 1 +
        BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (z - x) (BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.normalCoefficient β) +
      BfgsVerification.FixedNormal.cutoffResidual a (z - x) β
